bio.text: Justin Murphy is the Republican candidate for U.S. Senate in New Jersey, challenging Democratic Sen. Cory Booker.
Murphy, who is in his early 60s, was raised in the Pinelands region of South Jersey and lives in Tabernacle Township.
WHYY reports that he enlisted in the U.S. Navy at 17, graduated from Rowan University, and received a law degree from Widener University School of Law.
He has worked as an attorney in real estate, contracts and energy.

sources.title: New Jersey election 2026: Cory Booker faces 3 challengers in U.S. Senate race. Here's what to know
